climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A large irrigated region in the Big Rivers zone of New South Wales, centered on Griffith and relying heavily on the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Scheme. Shiraz and Chardonnay lead the plantings.
